text: we are in the same situation, i got my first b1 visa in 2022 while my annulment was in process in the philippines. after a year the process is still not finished. they gave me another 6 months, the annulment process in the philippines is long you are lucky, in a year it will be finished immediately. my annulment took almost five years, but i was given a visa sometimes 6 months, sometimes 3 months. but i have a good and very supportive lawyer. you should have a lawyer who will fight for your rights and your partner
